  1. 01

    Squeektoshi sets the pace

    A real hamster’s wheel reports its work on Squeekchain. We check every 20 seconds.

  2. 02

    The work sets the chapter

    0 new work: a cozy Nap. 1–499: a Journey. 500 or more: a Storm.

  3. 03

    You choose the next turn

    Join the village and choose a path. The next chapter remembers your character and choice.

Rounds follow the work observed in this browser. A quiet spell gets one Nap Chapter, starting with the first reading. The story uses seeded templates; your local choice shapes the continuation.
